hook: Your golf ball can cross a border.
title: Your Golf Ball Can Fly Into Another Country
description:
The Green Zone golf course sits on the Sweden-Finland border at Haparanda and Tornio. Part of the course is in each country, and Finland is one hour ahead of Sweden. Same round, two countries, two time zones.

#Shorts #Geography #PlacesThatShouldntExist
